prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your new companion is officially registered to your desktop habitat."]
1: ["Ambient Habitat Audio", "Pet hatching animation"]
2: ["Quick Companion Desktop Commands", "Learn how to summon, feed, or hide your companion anytime using simple desktop hotkeys.", "Press Alt+P to toggle desktop visibility"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Habitat", "Preview desktop habitat sounds and themes while your custom pet finishes generating.", "Desktop Habitat Live Preview"]
4: ["Listen closely to hear your pet getting ready in its background desktop habitat!"]
5: ["Choose Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "Full size companion visual presentation"]
6: ["Your companion will appear directly on your desktop taskbar once setup is complete."]
7: ["Welcome Your Companion to Your Desktop", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, access settings, or start a voice interaction."]
8: ["Pet Generation in Progress", "We will send a desktop notification as soon as your companion is ready to meet you."]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Swipe to explore how your desktop pet lives and interacts with your workspace."]
